title: Assessment
description: A Minecraft mod based on the video game Risk of Rain 2
body:
Assessment is a mod based on the roguelike shooter Risk of Rain 2, adding various items, equipment, a few enemies, and a dimension, the Simulacrum from the game.

**Currently the mod is in an early test phase, not containing most of the intended content.**\
**We are working on it.**

Full scale of content to await:
- most, if not all of the items from the game,
- four sets of armor related to playable characters in ror2, their weapons included,
- a few entities, including Gups and Void Reavers,
- a new dimension, the Simulacrum, with a way to access it and its own horde-based spawns.

Mod contents already completed (to be updated as the mod nears completion):
- 12 items,
- 1 block (wip),
- 1 entity (possibly bound to change)

Credits:
- the game Risk of Rain 2 is developed by Gearbox Software,
- textures by Syrphoidea, ThatAncient2 and DeliShoes,
- programming by ThatAncient2 and DeliShoes
